nom: Bliss Jelly Glow Peel Enzyme Cleanser and Exfoliator - 4 Oz - Vegan Formula

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, reporting no irritation even after deliberately scrubbing hard to test it, with some calling it a must-buy for sensitive skin; one reviewer with sensitive, dehydrated, acne-prone skin, however, reports it "set my face on fire."
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose skin flakes all winter, describe the product as a game changer for removing flaking without over-drying, generally reporting no irritation and a smoother, more glowing result.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or flaking skin report the product effectively removes flaking without over-drying, including one who calls it a game changer for winter flaking; one reviewer whose flakiness stems from medication and a hospital stay says it worked on most of her face but left noticeable residue on the finer hair near her jawline.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the product "set my face on fire," requiring cold water and aloe vera to calm her skin over several days; this is the only report of a redness or burning reaction in the reviews supplied.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report no irritation or stripping of the skin barrier, with one specifically noting it smooths skin around healing spots without further irritation; one reviewer with sensitive, dehydrated, acne-prone skin reports a severe burning reaction.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone report the product does not irritate or cause new breakouts and helps skin around healing spots recover faster; one reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive skin is the exception, reporting a severe reaction.

aspects.libelle: Dead skin balls up and can be hard to rinse off, especially with facial hair
Recent reformulation reportedly clumpier or stickier than the original
Gentle, non-abrasive feel despite strong exfoliation
Some bottles arrive opened, underfilled, or with residue on the lid
Seen as strong value for the price

extraits.texte: I have sensitive, dehydrated, acne prone skin. I love the Bliss Rose Rescue products, but this set my face on FIRE. Day 2 after using it, and I am still rinsing my face with ice cold water, rubbing an ice cube over everything, and moisturizing with nothing but alcohol free Aloe Vera or Cica Balm. Another important note: this product contains coconut.

I have Quite a bit of flakiness and dead skin cells on my face due to medications I'm taking and being in the hospital for quite some time. Was hoping this cleanser would help. It does work on most of my face.....sadly ....even tho' rinsed and rinsed in the shower still had {and have} quite a bit of the residue on the lower part of my face where the "peach fuzz" is. Love the fragrance and the feel of the cleanser......sadly a no go for me. I love all the Bliss products.....just not this item.

I have been repurchasing this for years now, I will never remove it from my skin care routine!! I have very dry and sensitive skin, but this is an absolute necessity for me in getting all the flaky skin off my face so that my makeup applies smoothly and my skin looks smooth and glowy overall. Some reviewers have mentioned that it can be difficult to rinse off completely, which I do agree with to some extent, but really it just takes a little longer to rinse off than a typical face wash. Additionally, I use this in the middle of my double cleanser face wash routine; after removing my makeup with micellar water, I use an oil cleanser to remove any additional dirt & makeup, then this Bliss Jelly Scrub, and follow with my second hydrating glycerin based cleanser using a soft face wash brush. I really like to use my second cleanser after the exfoliating scrub to help lift and rinse any remaining product off my face and neck as well as ensure that the new skin under all the dry skin that was removed is fresh and clean before applying my toners, face masks, serums, moisturizer, etc. My skin can be acne prone as well, but I find that this exfoliator does not irritate or break me out. In fact, I love how well it smooths out the dry skin around any healing spots without stripping my skin barrier or causing any further irritation, allowing my face to heal and renew much quicker than without it. extraits.titre: Really, really works! Not a gimmick!!
extraits.texte: This product is a game changer! I have extremely dry skin that flakes all winter long making it near impossible to put on makeup without it looking cakey and terrible. I bought this thinking it may well be just a gimmick. I assure you, it is not! The first time I used it it immediately balled up under my fingers (weird) and I washed it off. I did a second peel just to see, and I got a lot fewer balls and I had to scrub pretty vigorously to get any. I did a 3rd wash just to see and NO little balls at all. Crazy! Then I put on moisturizer and it was like my skin was brand new. Mind you the product is completely smooth and feels so gentle like you aren't doing anything abrasive. I have used a clairsonic, had dermaplaning facials, scrubbed with an abrasive facial sponge, NOTHING has helped my peely skin like this. Been using about 3-4 times a week. I will say the little balls of skin are kinda pesky to get rid of as some reviewers also said. They'll get stuck in your hair if you're not careful. I just do my peel before I shower so i can be sure they all get washed away. Totally, totally worth it. I'll be a customer for life.

My skin is really sensitive, so I make sure what I buy and check the ingredients in the products so far the ingredients do not seem harsh so I really like that and it does not contain sulfates. I scrub it as hard to see if I will rash my skin but it didn’t my skin feel so clean and gentle and even lighter .. it feel firmer as well.. MUST BUY IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN❤️❤️

I had something similar to this before, so when I saw it was a gel based exfoliater, I got excited. The scent is mildly off-putting, but not terrible. I have dry, sensitive, skin and this worked beautifully. I didn't get irritated and it left a healthy glow afterwards.

extraits.titre: Excellent Product, coming from a former Esthetician
extraits.texte: I have read the reviews on this I do not understand why no one has ever done the "test," on a product to see if it is the product that is rolling up or if your dead, flaky skin is actually coming off. Steps for the test: Get a smooth surface: bottom of a glass bowl will do. Put on gloves; keeps your skin from being exposed to product. Wet bottom of bowl; see instructions on tube. Put small amount of product on gloved fingertips. Start "applying" product to bottom of bowl in circular motion; once again see instructions on tube. Massage product in circular motion for 30 seconds or longer. Did the product bead up and become gummy? No, then the product isn't to blame for the gummy beads. Did the product just get spread in a large circular pattern? Second part of Test: Apply warm water to back of opposite hand or arm from the gloved hand. Apply small amount of product to gloved finger tips. Apply to back of hand or arm in a circular motion. Massage product for 30 seconds or longer. Did product bead up? If yes, then this is your old skin releasing and being removed. Did product evaporate and do nothing? Then this product isn't for you, you do not have dry skin issues. I spent several years looking for a product like this, I used something very similar to this for extremely dry or acned skin in facials. Only kicker it cost up to $600 retail of one ounce. I couldn't even afford it at Wholesale price. This works exactly like it is supposed to and is excellent for skin the is eczemic,
